description: END29 amendment, synthetic, code-derived (not seen in the field): Teams releases its input for a headphone switch at 900 s and the mic's return never reaches the engine. The call runs on with the Leave button and the window live, and the Leave element flickers invalid twice (a screen-share re-render: 8.3 s at 2100 s, 38.3 s at 3000 s, the reliability audit's measured lengths). END18 declines each return because the mic ended inside the hold. Before the owner's answer of 2026-11-18 the lone dwell ran from the first return and ended the call at 2828.3 s, cut back to the switch; now a declined Leave that has read live for confirmDwell refuses again, and the call never ends on the lone dwell.
